lines: Seat 1 chooses Hearthkeeper: at the end, 1 point per Steady tile held, up to 3.
Seat 2 chooses Weaver: at the end, 1 point per 2 tiles in your largest connected group beyond the first 2, up to 3.
Pass: you pay nothing and get one of the tiles nobody wins, at random.
Bid 4 mana on the Wild tile at (-1, 0) (yields 4).
If yours is the only highest bid, you pay 4 and keep 5 mana.
If you're outbid or tied, you pay nothing and get one of the tiles nobody wins, at random.
A tie for the Wild tile at (-1, 0) (yields 4) at 4 mana: nobody gets it.
Seat 1 gets the Shifting tile at (1, 0) (yields 1) for free.
Seat 2 gets the Wild tile at (2, -1) (yields 2) for free.
Seat 3 gets the Wild tile at (-1, 0) (yields 4) for free.
Bid 3 mana on the Steady tile at (-2, 0) (yields 2).
If yours is the only highest bid, you pay 3 and keep 6 mana.
If you're outbid or tied, you pay nothing and get one of the tiles nobody wins, at random.
Bid 3 mana on the Shifting tile at (0, 0) (yields 2).
If yours is the only highest bid, you pay 3 and keep 6 mana.
If you're outbid or tied, you pay nothing and get one of the tiles nobody wins, at random.
Seat 2 wins the Shifting tile at (0, 0) (yields 2) for 3 mana.
Seat 1 wins the Steady tile at (-2, 0) (yields 2) for 3 mana.
Seat 3 gets the Wild tile at (-1, 2) (yields 1) for free.
Bid 2 mana on the Steady tile at (2, 0) (yields 2).
If yours is the only highest bid, you pay 2 and keep 4 mana.
If you're outbid or tied, you pay nothing and get one of the tiles nobody wins, at random.
Bid 2 mana on the Steady tile at (2, 0) (yields 2).
If yours is the only highest bid, you pay 2 and keep 4 mana.
If you're outbid or tied, you pay nothing and get one of the tiles nobody wins, at random.
A tie for the Steady tile at (2, 0) (yields 2) at 2 mana: nobody gets it.
Seat 3 wins the Steady tile at (-2, 1) (yields 2) for 2 mana.
Seat 1 gets the Wild tile at (-1, -1) (yields 3) for free.
Seat 2 gets the Steady tile at (2, 0) (yields 2) for free.
The opening is over. The rounds begin.
Seat 1's trait is Hearthkeeper.
Seat 2's trait is Weaver.
Seat 3's trait is Warbrand.
Round 1 of 8 begins.
Seat 1 collects 6 mana.
Seat 2 collects 6 mana.
Seat 3 collects 7 mana.
Attune the Steady tile at (1, 1) (yields 2) for 10 mana, leaving 2. If a rival attunes it too, nobody gets it.
Summon 4 Golems at (0, 0) for 8 mana, leaving 4.
Round 1.
Seat 1 attunes the Steady tile at (1, 1) (yields 2) for 10 mana.
Seat 3 attunes the Wild tile at (0, -1) (yields 4) for 10 mana.
Seat 2 summons 4 Golems at (0, 0).
Seat 1 banks 1 point (1 for land, 0 for mana), 1 in all.
Seat 2 banks 1 point (1 for land, 0 for mana), 1 in all.
Seat 3 banks 1 point (1 for land, 0 for mana), 1 in all.
Round 2 of 8 begins.
An Unveil reveals the Shifting tile at (0, -2) (yields 2); the Shifting tile at (2, -2) (yields 2, guarded by power 3); the Steady tile at (0, 2) (yields 2); the Wild tile at (-2, 2) (yields 1).
Seat 1 collects 8 mana.
Seat 2 collects 6 mana.
Seat 2 pays 4 mana upkeep.
Seat 3 collects 11 mana.
